items.note: SEED DATA — verify against manufacturer page before launch

items.model: 10 PACK of RDQ Series / - Plastic Head 380mAh 1S

items.note: Size withheld: the listing prints "Pack Dimension: 44x8x72mm (HxWxL)" beside "Net Weight: 106g (+/-4g)", and 106 g in 25.3 cm3 is 4.18 g/cm3 - denser than the 2.7-2.9 of a bare 18650 cell, so no pack of cells is that size. The weight is the figure that survives its other check (155 Wh/kg, ordinary for a 6S LiHV micro pack), and the 8 is the suspect figure: the RDQ Series 720mAh 6S sold beside it - same capacity, cell count and C-rating - prints 74x44x18.5mm at 103 g. That is a different product, so its 18.5 is not written here. Gaoneng publishes no product page of its own - gnbbattery.com serves no catalogue - so there is no second figure to take

The size is the housing's, not a pouch's: 105x35x31.5 mm around a 550mAh 4S is 0.60 g/cm3, a third of what a pack of cells weighs for its volume, because this pack is a moulded, vented shell with a latch and slide rails that only the Defender 25 accepts. iFlight's own page states the same 105*35*31.5mm (and the same three figures for the 900mAh version at 100 g - a size that does not move with the capacity is the enclosure's), 70+/-2 g, 8.14 Wh, 4S1P, 60C and XT30, so every figure here is the manufacturer's as well as the retailer's

Size withheld: the listing prints "Dimensions: 79x23x34mm" beside "Weight: 212.5g (+/- 1%)", which is 3.44 g/cm3 - denser than any lithium cell sold, so the two figures cannot both describe this pack. The weight is the one that survives its other check (146 Wh/kg, ordinary for a 3S LiPo), and at this class's 1.7-1.9 g/cm3 the pack would be about 112-125 cm3 against the 62 the three figures give. RDQ Series is RaceDayQuads' own house brand, so there is no second source to take a replacement from

items.model: RDQ Series FPV Wing or Drone 2200mAh 3S

items.note: Weight and size are Tattu's own, not the retailer's: RaceDayQuads prints 63 g and 63x16x12 mm for this pack, and 63 g on 550mAh 2S is 65 Wh/kg - half the density of every other pack in the class, i.e. another object's figure. Gens Ace/Tattu's own product page for TA-RL-95C-550-2S1P-XT30 states Net Weight(+/-5g) 31.5 g and 61 mm L x 19 mm W x 15 mm H. Capacity, cell count, C-rating and connector agree on both pages
